Only remote links are used; recordings are not redistributed or automatically downloaded.
Audio streaming availability depends on the original host and the user's connection.

Quran reading font: KFGQPC Uthmanic Script HAFS, version 0.09 (MadinahHafsClassic.ttf), distributed unmodified under the included KFGQPC-HAFS-LICENSE.txt.
Typeface reference: https://qurancomplex.gov.sa/riwaiat-hafs/ ; distributed copy: https://github.com/nuqayah/qpc-fonts/blob/master/various/UthmanicHafs1%20Ver09.otf .
Only the reading typeface changed in 1.0.79; Quran text, font-size preferences, page structure and styling are preserved. Amiri Quran remains the fallback for marked words and unsupported glyphs.

Additional full-Quran reciters in 1.0.79: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais (https://www.mp3quran.net/ar/sds/downloads) and Mishary Al-Afasy (https://www.mp3quran.net/ar/afs/downloads), all 114 surahs. Individual ayah playback uses EveryAyah directories Abdurrahmaan_As-Sudais_192kbps and Alafasy_128kbps. Provider catalogues and both directory listings were checked on 24 October 2026. Audio is streamed on request, not bundled or automatically downloaded.

Sudais replacement recording (1.0.80), shown once as عبدالرحمن السديس: 114 complete-surah MP3 links from the published studio collection at https://archive.org/details/a0s0261002ddddddddddd . Listing and attribution: https://alkabbah.com/recitations/playlist/803492/nskh-astodyo-114-sor-kaml-mshf-alsdys-128-k-b-asdar-gdyd-aabd-alrhmn-alsdys . Official existence of a studio release: https://www.spa.gov.sa/N2563619 . The exact mirror-to-official-video match and subjective sound quality were not independently auditioned. Durations differ from the legacy set; no matching ayah timestamps were supplied. It streams complete surahs without an estimated ayah cursor. The previous Sudais verse and surah sources are no longer used; the other four readers retain individual ayah playback. Old saved files are never substituted for the studio URLs. No recording is bundled or automatically downloaded.
